evidence.quote: If you have 2FA enabled you can not use the user's password for git push, you have to create either app token in user settings or use that instead of password or use ssh protocol.

confirmation.quote: i will try app token, thanks!

notes: Deliberate 2FA enforcement on password basic auth; user must use an access token; toggling 2FA reproduces it, so no server/infra factor.

reviews.decidable_why: Body states 2FA enabled + HTTPS push fails; Gitea source explicitly rejects password basic auth for 2FA users.
The body states push fails only with 2FA enabled over HTTPS; source auth code explicitly refuses password basic auth for 2FA users.
